start.content: From the ridge we watched Jerusalem below us while He spoke of the end of the age. The discourse moved between warning and hope with unsettling clarity.

warning.content: He said many would deceive in His name, and many would grow cold as lawlessness increased. We were told to test spirits, endure, and not chase every panic.

hope.content: He promised the gospel would reach all nations, and that the Son of Man would come with power and glory. History is not chaos to Him; it is appointment.

cosmic.content: He spoke of sun and moon darkening and the nations in distress. But His final emphasis was simple: stay awake and be ready, because no one knows the hour.
